name: workhorse
description: Hand coding, review and ops jobs to Codex as background subagents, with a job board, stall watchdog and completion notices

hide_codex_rescue.title: Hide Codex rescue agent
hide_codex_rescue.description: Hide codex:codex-rescue from Claude to avoid competing with workhorse delegation

lang.title: Job language
lang.description: Job and mod language: zh or en; empty uses zh for the mod

command_minutes.title: Command minutes before warning
command_minutes.description: Warn once per command text after this many running minutes; never terminate the command

done_linger_minutes.title: Finished job visibility
done_linger_minutes.description: Minutes to keep finished jobs visible while other jobs run

report_max_chars.title: Report character limit
report_max_chars.description: Maximum report characters included in completion notices

goal_columns.title: Goal column limit
goal_columns.description: Maximum terminal columns for each job goal

keep_days.title: Job retention days
keep_days.description: Days of job history retained by engine cleanup

skip_skills.title: Skills to skip
skip_skills.description: Comma-separated skills Codex should not read; empty disables skill skipping

test_pattern.title: Test command pattern
test_pattern.description: Pattern used by the engine to count test commands; empty uses the engine default

banned_phrases.title: Comma-separated forbidden brief phrases
banned_phrases.default: baseline,全量测试,full test suite,前后对比,before/after
